تستثمرون (form X)
# تَسْتَثْمِرُونَ (tastaṯmirūna) /tas.taθ.mi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَثْمَرَ (istaṯmara)
# تُسْتَثْمَرُونَ (tustaṯmarūna) /tus.taθ.ma.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَثْمَرَ (istaṯmara)
